response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for an ankle sprain sustained during a trip. Clause A4.1 covers medical expenses, including prescribed medication, resulting from an acute illness or injury during travel. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing (A5.1), planned (A5.2), or related to alcohol, war, terrorism, or nuclear events (A11.2, A11.4). Additionally, the policy includes extreme sports (A11.3), but this incident is not related to such activities. Therefore, the claim is covered under A4.1."}
